sentences.text: Petitioner is directed to produce documents to show that on the date of the publication of the notification under Section 4 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, petitioner's land was included in the notification and either it was not acquired or was subsequently acquired without compensation as per the awards dated 20.11.1987 and 23.03.1990 passed by the Land Acquisition Officer, Tones Hydel Project, Sirmaur, District Rewa in case No.82/87-88 and 82/89-90.
He will also produce copies of relevant documents to show his ownership on the date of issuance of notification under Section 4 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
Learned counsel for the petitioner prays for and is granted two weeks' time to do the needful.

(VIVEK AGARWAL) JUDGE pp Ravendra Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 17 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/53986913/
